g.text: Hồ Sơ Đăng Ký Chất Lượng
Lựa Chọn Cách Thử Trên Dòng Đơn
Largest number of that entity in the relationship; M is many
Weak entity: identified only within the entity it belongs to
Supporting relationship of a weak entity and the entity it belongs to
Composite (associative) entity: identified by the entities it links, each one-to-many
